$comment: ReelBolt cursor set — masters and contract. Sources: brand/cursors/src/*.svg. Rendered by brand/scripts/cursors.mjs; copied into the apps by brand/scripts/sync.mjs. Hotspots are in 32 px space (the @1x canvas). See docs/design/cursors.md.

cursors.name: default
cursors.intent: The resting pointer: an angled arrow whose tip is the exact click point.

cursors.name: pointer
cursors.intent: A pointing hand for links and buttons, fingertip on the target.

cursors.name: text
cursors.intent: An I-beam that marks where typing will land in editable text.

cursors.name: not-allowed
cursors.intent: A barred disc for a control that cannot take the action.

cursors.name: progress
cursors.intent: A static busy arc for work in flight; never animated.

cursors.name: grab
cursors.intent: An open hand for content that can be dragged.

cursors.name: grabbing
cursors.intent: A closed fist for a drag already in progress.

cursors.name: move
cursors.intent: A four-way arrow for repositioning an element in any direction.

cursors.name: resize-ew
cursors.intent: A horizontal double arrow for left-right sizing.

cursors.name: resize-ns
cursors.intent: A vertical double arrow for up-down sizing.

cursors.name: resize-nwse
cursors.intent: A corner double arrow for the top-left to bottom-right diagonal.

cursors.name: resize-nesw
cursors.intent: A corner double arrow for the top-right to bottom-left diagonal.

cursors.name: razor
cursors.intent: The blade tool's cut point, for splitting a clip at the click.

cursors.name: trim-left
cursors.intent: The in-point trim edge: a vertical bar with an arrow pointing left.

cursors.name: trim-right
cursors.intent: The out-point trim edge: a vertical bar with an arrow pointing right.

cursors.name: ripple
cursors.intent: A ripple edit closing the gap toward the cut line.

cursors.name: slip
cursors.intent: A slip trim: the clip frame stays, its source shifts inside it.

cursors.name: slide
cursors.intent: A slide trim: the clip and its neighbours shift along the track; arrows point outward.

cursors.name: pan
cursors.intent: The hand tool for moving the viewer or timeline without editing: an open hand framed by four arrowheads.

cursors.name: scrub
cursors.intent: Dragging the playhead: a pentagon head on a full-height line with drag chevrons either side.

cursors.name: mask-draw
cursors.intent: Drawing a mask region with a precise targeting crosshair.

cursors.name: mask-brush
cursors.intent: Painting a layer mask; the bristle tip is the point of action.

cursors.name: eyedropper
cursors.intent: Picking a colour from the canvas; the dropper tip is the point of action.

cursors.name: keyframe
cursors.intent: A keyframe diamond for marking a point on an animated channel.

cursors.name: zoom-in
cursors.intent: Zooming in; the lens centre is the point of action.

cursors.name: zoom-out
cursors.intent: Zooming out; the lens centre is the point of action.

cursors.name: crosshair
cursors.intent: A bare crosshair for precise or freeform placement.
